files.provenance: $438ee type plane (+0), $438ee-8257 height plane, $438ee+8257 flag plane, $3f86c control/height plane. Read by pm_render_terrain ($f898) for colour and pm_project_grid ($fec6/$fecc) for geometry (the projector reads $3f86c, entity sampling reads $438ee).
files.format: 64 x 128 cells, row-major, stride 64. 4 bytes/cell: [0]=type [1]=height [2]=flag [3]=control. water: height < 12 (0x0c); static-sea skip: flag & 0x80 (corner unmoved this frame).

per-scanline shifter palette captured from f000100.bin (ATARI_FRAME_DIR row-records). Written by the game to $FFFF8240.
files.format: distinct_palettes + per_row[200]. Each colour is a $0RGB shifter word; rgb[] is the 3-bit-per-gun expansion (x*255/7).

files.provenance: 4bpp pattern table at $2e000 (= long at $ff9e). Read by the span fill ($e3e6 setup, $e4de/$e4a6 inner loops -- 77th-pass aligned disasm). Per triangle: A5 = base + colourByte*128 + (topY & 15)*8 (byte address). Per 16-px screen cluster the fill reads two 32-bit big-endian longs: long0 = {plane0<<16 | plane1}, long1 at A5+4 = {plane2<<16 | plane3}; pixel index = plane0.bit | plane1.bit<<1 | plane2.bit<<2 | plane3.bit<<3 with bit = 15-(screenX & 15). A5 then advances +4 bytes/scanline (the roll) and +8 bytes/cluster.
files.format: 16384 bytes dumped (128 colourByte slots of 128 bytes = 16 eight-byte sub-patterns each; sub-pattern picked by (topY & 15), rolled +4 B/line). Big-endian. colourByte->index: 0x08-0x0b water (14/15), 0x18-0x1c rock (1-3/6), 0x24-0x2c grass ramp (13/12/11), 0x3e brightest (9/10/11).

files.format: sheet_raw.bin = 352 x 55 raw bytes. Each frame is 8 x 11 FOUR-bitplane (16-colour), 5 bytes/row = [AND-mask, plane0..3]; opaque where mask bit == 0. sheet_contact.png = 16-wide, 6x, real palette / magenta = clear. Frames 0-63 = men (4 faction blocks of 16); 0x117 = animals; 0x100/0x10f/0x13e/0x14e/0x150 = other categories -- see sprite_triggers.json for each category's base.
